action.description: What to do next. An action carries exactly the arguments it registers, or none when the result names no repository. index.rebuild, index.refresh, repo.inspect, operation.abandon and repo.identity_set take root, the repository's root. host.approve and host.replace take root and authority. request.retry takes request_id. operation.resume and request.prepare take none. operation.resume and operation.abandon set operation_id.
